note: The CSRF token binds the owner's Access subject; a script's service token needs none (ADR-0026 §2) and the owner's assertion cannot be made from a script. The CSRF refusals are the unit tests' (apps/environment/test/environmentSettings.test.ts), as for m3-panel-safety.json.

cases.name: service token + admin token reads the Environment settings
no Access credentials (GET and a change): refused at the edge
a forged Access assertion alone: refused at the edge
the service token without the admin token: refused
a wrong Origin, a cross-site fetch and a form-encoded body: refused
answers:
wrong origin
not same-origin
a change is JSON (Content-Type: application/json)

cases.name: a size not offered: refused with the setting named
cases.answer: containerSize: one of cpu-1, standard-1, standard-2, standard-3, standard-4
